description: Free, no sign-in needed: search the official Peppol Directory (directory.peppol.eu) by company name, Belgian enterprise/VAT number or Peppol ID such as 0208:0403170701, optionally in one country. Returns matching participants grouped per company: their Peppol IDs (scheme and ID), country, registration date and whether they list Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 invoices and credit notes; Belgian companies show whether 0208, 9925 or both are listed. Listing in the Directory is optional, so a missing company may still receive Peppol invoices — confirm a Belgian number live with check_peppol_receivability. Shares the 20 free calls per hour per connection with check_peppol_receivability.

country.description: ISO country code to limit a name search, e.g. 'BE'.

page.description: Result page of a name search (20 per page), 0 to 4.

query.description: Company name (at least 3 letters), Belgian enterprise or VAT number (BE0403170701), or Peppol ID (0208:0403170701).

name: search_peppol_directory
title: Search the Peppol Directory (free)
